messages:
alex chang: Kicking off perf validation for zur1 GPU bring-up. Goal: establish p50/p95 baselines for short-chat and long-stream profiles and confirm kernel/driver parity across nodes. starting with H100 pool.
maria velasquez: running an initial sweep now against the katana-short profile. smoke run config: 5 nodes, 4 concurrent clients, 3 min per step.
ryan m.: thx. remind folks to capture nvlink and driver checks before load — observed subtle p95 spikes with mixed driver levels last time.
alex chang: good call. run the probe that collects nvidia-smi/topo + kernel info and the perf agent logs. here's the command I'm using:
```
./tools/perf_sweep.sh --region zur1 --pool h100 --profiles katana-short,katana-long --batch-sizes 1,4,8 --step 180
```
infra-bot: perf_sweep job started (job_id=pf-zur1-2026-01). tagging results to bucket gs://redwood-perf/zur1/pf-zur1-2026-01
maria velasquez: first 3 steps done. p50=34ms p95=142ms on batch=1 for katana-short. p95 is higher than target (120ms). re-running with nvlink checks enabled.
ryan m.: can you paste the kernel/driver output from node-17? I want to confirm driver version + NV drivers.
maria velasquez: here's quick snippet from node-17:
```
$ uname -r
6.6.15-rt
$ nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,gpu_name --format=csv
Driver Version, Name
535.86.10, NVIDIA H100-SXM
$ nvidia-smi topo -m
GPU0  GPU1  CPU Affinity
GPU0  X     NV2
GPU1  NV2   X
```
maria velasquez: noticed a couple "E: nvlink peer reset" messages in /var/log/syslog during step 2 — correlates with the p95 spike.
ryan m.: nvlink resets + older 535.86.10 combo might cause transient stalls. plan: cordon node-17, drain, reprovision kernel+driver stack to 6.6.19 + 536.x driver on a small sample and re-test.
alex chang: agreed. cordoning node-17 now and re-running the sweep across the remaining 4 nodes to verify cluster-wide baseline.
infra-bot: node node-17 cordoned by alex chang (reason: nvlink-reset investigation).
sre-oncall: heads-up — if we lose node-17 capacity during handoff, autoscaler will spin up a replacement which may increase short-term cost by ~2-4% depending on job saturation. keep finance in loop if we expect longer reprovision window.
alex chang: noted. will limit additional rebuilds to a small canary set first. handoff checklist for eng-oncall when we finish:
- confirm p50/p95 for both profiles under steady-state (3 runs each)
- kernel+driver matrix documented in perf bucket
- NVLINK/noise anomalies triaged or mitigated (cordoned nodes replaced)
- cost delta estimate and ops window
- assign postmortem owner if anomalies persist
maria velasquez: re-run (canary) on 4 nodes: katana-short p50=33ms p95=118ms, katana-long p95 stable at 240ms under 2x concurrency. attaching perf artifact path: gs://redwood-perf/zur1/pf-zur1-2026-01/artifacts/canary
ryan m.: looks good. i'll patch the infra provisioner to pin 536.x drivers for the initial fleet roll so we don't get mixed-driver churn.
alex chang: perfect. i'll finish the write-up and hand this to platform-release for a controlled rollout tomorrow 0200 UTC. leaving node-17 reprovision as a follow-on task assigned to maria.
maria velasquez: on it — will report back once node-17 is rebuilt and back in pool. :thumbsup:
__notes: This thread captures a short, realistic eng-infra Slack conversation about performance validation during a new region/cluster bring-up. Messages are intentionally concise and include commands, logs, and next steps to mimic real Slack threads.
